monitored_entity.title: Monitored entity
monitored_entity.description: Pick the entity to watch. The next step adapts to whether it is a switch/toggle, a number or text.

data_description.name: Defaults to the entity's name with " status" appended.
data_description.labels: Applied to the new sensor so an Aggregator can pick it up.

data.unavailable_is: When there is no value (unavailable / unknown / null)

data_description.hysteresis: Optional. The value must move this far past the threshold to clear a problem, to stop flapping.

aggregator.title: Aggregator
aggregator.description: One problem sensor that turns on whenever a labelled entity is in a problem state.

data_description.labels: Every entity carrying one of these labels is watched.
data_description.match: "any" watches entities in any selected label; "all" only watches entities carrying every selected label.
data_description.problem_states: Turns on when a watched entity's state is one of these. Monitored-entity sensors (device class "problem") are always included.
